name: Rare Fish - Brownell's Blue Striped Racer
summary: A fishing record marks Brownell's Blue Striped Racer as identified. The identification is complete.

sections.title: The Record
sections.body: A brief signal follows the identification of Brownell's Racer. Brownell's Blue Striped Racer is marked complete, and a reward is available.

faq.q: What is Brownell's Blue Striped Racer?
faq.answer: Brownell's Blue Striped Racer is the fish whose identification is marked complete.
Yes. The identification of Brownell's Racer is complete.
Yes. A reward is available after the identification is complete.
